text:
Kate M: ok team — we need a doc-as-spec thread for the new "Model Canary" quickstart/examples. want to land runnable examples + clear acceptance criteria so SEs can validate canary behavior in prod and private deployments.
Linh T: sounds good. do you want the examples to focus on API calls only or include Console steps? also need to surface edgecases (long context, tool calls, partial responses)
Kate M: prioritize API + minimal curl + JS SDK for v1. console screenshot can be follow-up. main goal: docs that double as an integration test checklist.
Julian R: FYI runtime has a few gotchas: prefix caching affects canary perf numbers, and batching can hide latency regressions. we should call those out explicitly in ACs.
Sasha P: customer ask from FinFlow: they want deterministic fallback when canary fails (auto rollback to stable model) + observable signal in console. include that as launch criteria.
Linh T: ok draft idea — split doc into: 1) quickstart (curl + node) 2) canonical examples (streaming, function calls, embeddings compare) 3) verification steps + expected metrics 4) edgecases + troubleshooting
Kate M: +1. can we make verification steps machine-checkable? like exact steps someone can run and assert latency/accuracy thresholds.
engdocs-bot: reminder: use the PRD -> Docs-driven workflow. include AC, examples, code snippets, and a short eval prompt set.
Linh T: sketching ACs below — please react with :thumbsup: if these look right:

```
Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Quickstart guide with curl and Node.js example that starts a canary rollout (one API call each)
- [ ] Example for streaming responses with expected event order documented
- [ ] Example of function/tool call with sample tool interface and expected output format
- [ ] Verification script (bash + jq) that validates: 95th pct latency <= X ms on canary, error rate < 0.5%, and fallback triggers on failure
- [ ] Documentation note on batching and prefix-caching impacts with recommended flags/config
- [ ] Console: visible canary state and automatic rollback option documented
- [ ] Small eval prompt set (5 prompts) with expected rubric for semantic drift detection
```

Julian R: need to define X ms — suggest X = 1.5x baseline stable model p95 for same seq len. also note env noise (cross-tenant) — put recommended smoke infra: 10 warmup requests + 200 samples under p95 measurement.
Kate M: agree. add AC line: "baseline p95 must be provided by owner and referenced in doc". also add acceptance condition for security review for Private deployments.
Sasha P: add launch criteria: internal dogfood for 2 customers, sign-off from eng-runtime and security, docs reviewed by SE. timeline: target beta in 2 sprints.
Linh T: edgecases to document: 1) huge context (>32k) — show truncation example 2) partial streaming then reconnect — show how to resume 3) tool mis-spec (bad schema) — show error payload and recommended handling 4) mixed-quant models fallback mismatch
Kate M: can we include a tiny troubleshooting section with snips? e.g.
```
# common failures
- "kv cache miss" logs -> rewarm by sending 50 short requests
- "batch overflow" -> lower batch_max_tokens in client config
- function call schema mismatch -> 400 with message: "schema mismatch: expected ..."
```

Julian R: good. i'll add a small test script (node) to the examples repo that runs the verification steps and prints pass/fail. i'll also add an env var to toggle simulated errors so SEs can test rollback.
Linh T: i'll draft the doc skeleton tonight and open a PR. can I get content owners: runtime (Julian), security (Sasha), PM (Kate). pls add comments in PR for edgecase wording.
Kate M: thank you. i'll drop the customer ask (FinFlow) details in the PR and the baseline numbers. feel free to ping me for clarifications.
Sasha P: will review security ACs — quick note: for Private we need KMS key rotation guidance and audit log examples.
engdocs-bot: template applied: docs/quickstarts/model-canary -- please include metadata: owners, components, test-plan.
Linh T: cool — i'll open PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/942 once draft is ready. low-friction: if we miss a console screenshot we can ship without but mark as follow-up.
Kate M: sounds like a plan. next: Linh to PR, Julian to add test script, Sasha to add security blurb. target PR review by EOD Thursday. :rocket:
